IncidentDef.label: subspace anomaly
IncidentDef.letterText: Sensors detect a massive subspace anomaly enveloping the region. The intense gravimetric and subspace distortions are scrambling all long-range frequencies, completely disabling orbital trade and comms.\n\nMedical officers also report that the interference is heavily dampening telepathic and psionic abilities across the colony.

GameConditionDef.label: subspace anomaly
GameConditionDef.description: Severe subspace distortions are blocking long-range communications and heavily dampening psionic abilities.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The subspace anomaly has dissipated. Communications and psionic networks are fully restored.

li.label: subspace anomaly
li.description: The ambient subspace interference is completely scrambling my thoughts. It feels like static in my brain, making it impossible to tap into any psionic frequencies.
